description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework that gives you Express simplicity, Fastify performance, and built‑in AI‑driven routing for edge‑ready apps.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the 2026 hype around AI‑first back‑ends and edge computing: highlight built‑in LLM routing, automatic HTTP/2‑3 & gRPC support, and zero‑config deployment to Cloudflare Workers, Bun, and Deno. Pair that with a "zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast" tagline that directly competes with Express and Fastify in search keywords, while the version number (daily build) signals rapid innovation and community momentum.
download_hooks: Developers pick yantravese for its Express‑style API with Fastify‑grade throughput—no extra dependencies to audit.
Performance angle: native HTTP/2, HTTP/3, gRPC, and WebSocket handling out of the box deliver sub‑millisecond latency on edge runtimes.
Developer experience angle: automatic TypeScript inference, zero‑config deployment to Cloudflare Workers, Bun, and Deno, plus AI‑driven route generation that cuts boilerplate by 80%.
